answer: Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A canyon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wharf of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim.
